## The project
A nursing study tool that generates personalized care plans based on your practice performance. It tracks which topics you've missed and helps you reinforce weak areas by distributing topics strategically across daily plans. The recent work balanced distribution (max 2 topics per client-need per day) and added visibility into patterns in your misses.

## Rules in force

**Storage & scope:**
- **rule**: Keep everything in plain JSON files, no database. You want to be able to open the journal in a text editor on your phone.
- **rule**: Don't package or put it on GitHub. It's personal-use only right now.

- **rule** (agent note): Never include actual question text from paid qbanks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan) — even paraphrased. Topic tags and your own notes only.
- **rule** (agent note): No gamification, streaks, or leaderboards. It's a distraction for now; maybe later.

**Nursing scope:**
- **rule**: Everything in the plan must be within PN (practical nurse) scope of practice — reinforce, monitor, report, follow the care plan.
